en.t: Life and death are ordinary facts of the human world.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子只见过夕颜一人之死，或所见不多，因此哭泣之哀，异乎寻常。

en.t: But Prince Genji had only witnessed the death of Yugao, perhaps because he had seen little of death, and so the grief in his weeping was extraordinary.

units.source_text: 时在八月二十过后，残月当空，凄凉无限。

en.t: It was after the twentieth day of the eighth month; the waning moon hung in the sky, and the desolation was boundless.

units.source_text: 左大臣在归途上思念亡女，心情郁结，愁眉不展。

en.t: On the way home, the Minister of the Left thought of his dead daughter, his heart weighed down and his brows clouded with sorrow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，十分同情，益增悲戚，

en.t: Seeing this, Prince Genji felt deep sympathy, and his own sorrow grew still greater,

units.source_text: 两眼只管眺望天空，吟道：

en.t: his eyes fixed only on the sky, he recited:
